===CPU 單板===
001_Show Information==>>show system version
fan speed 25=fan all speed 25
fan speed 40=fan all speed 40
002_Read CPU Board intel and I210 SPI flash version==>>/intel_nvm_flash_update_tool/eeupdate64e /ALL /ADAPTERINFO
003_eMMC Read/Write==>>emmc test config size 16 count 1 mode 0,1
004_DRAM Read/Write==>>memory test config size 16 count 1
005_SPI Flash Read/Write==>/mfg_sources/SPI_test.sh 1024
006_SSD Read/Write==>ssd test config size 64 count 1 mode 0,1
007_Reset Test==>[no command example]
008_Temperature status==>show system temp_sensor
009_Enable Burn-In (rst-conf)==>/diag_test --rst-conf Gemini pt
010_Enable Burn-In (Burn-in)==>/diag_test --burn-in-set on --pwr-cyc-num 16 --tfc-pkt-t 28
011_Enable Burn-In (PT-4C)==>/diag_test --burn-in-set on --pwr-cyc-num 16 --tfc-pkt-t 28
012_LED All test==>led port all all off==>led port all all red==>led port all all yellow==>led port all all white==>led port all all green

===SW_V0415_table===
001_Show Information==>show system version
002_eMMC Read/Write==>emmc test config size 16 count 1 mode 0,1
003_DRAM Read/Write==>memory test config size 16 count 1
004_SSD Read/Write==>ssd test config size 64 count 1 mode 0,1
005_Temperature status==>show system temp_sensor
006_Show Information==>show system version
007_eMMC Read/Write==>emmc test config size 16 count 1 mode 0,1
008_DRAM Read/Write==>memory test config size 16 count 1
009_SSD Read/Write==>ssd test config size 64 count 1 mode 0,1
010_USB Read/Write==>usb test config size 16 count 1 mode 0,1
011_LED Green On==>led system sys green==>led system pwr green==>led system fan green==>led system bmc green
012_LED All Off==>led system sys off==>led system pwr off==>led system fan off==>led system loc off==>led system bmc off==>led system fan_tray off==>led port all all off
013_Show Temperature==>show system temp_sensor
014_Show Adc Voltage==>show system adc
015_Read Fan Status==>show fan
016_I2C Test==>i2c device test
017_Hardware Monitor==>show system adc==>show fan==>show system temp_sensor
